summary.text: Seth King is a Republican state representative from Coos District 4 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where he has served since December 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Seth King assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 7, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee for 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Coos 4, where Dave Holmander is also a candidate.
